shortDescription: Thailand’s imports rose 25.1% year-on-year in August 2026, slowing from a 36.7% surge in the previous month and marking the weakest growth since December 2025.The latest result fell short of market expectations for a 33% increase, suggesting softer domestic demand and investment activity.

children: Thailand’s imports rose 25.1% year-on-year in August 2026, slowing from a 36.7% surge in the previous month and marking the weakest growth since December 2025.
The latest result fell short of market expectations for a 33% increase, suggesting softer domestic demand and investment activity.

title: Thailand Import Growth Below Estimates
